subject: DI02005011

body.en:
Definition

An ideal gas obeys PV=nRT exactly in the model, with negligible molecular volume and no intermolecular interactions except elastic collisions.

Explanation and use

  • Use absolute pressure and absolute temperature.R=8.3144626J/(mol·K)=8.3144626kPa·m³/(kmol·K)=0.082057L·atm/(mol·K).
  • R must match pressure, volume and mole units.Low pressure and temperature sufficiently above condensation often improve the approximation; real gases need nonideality corrections.
  • For real gas comparison, Z=PV/(nRT); ideal Z=1.No claim is made that all gases at all temperatures are ideal.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Ideal gas modelમાં molecular volume negligible તથા elastic collisions સિવાય intermolecular interactions નહીં, અને PV=nRT માન્ય છે.

સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Absolute P/T લો.R=8.3144626J/(mol·K)=8.3144626kPa·m³/(kmol·K)=0.082057L·atm/(mol·K).
  • R pressure, volume/mole units સાથે match થવો જોઈએ.Low P તથા condensationથી પૂરતું ઊંચું T approximation સુધારે; real gasesમાં corrections જોઈએ.
  • Real-gas comparisonમાં Z=PV/(nRT); ideal Z=1.બધા gas દરેક Tએ ideal છે એવો દાવો નથી.

body.en:
Definition

The ideal-gas equation relates equilibrium pressure, volume, amount and absolute temperature of an ideal gas.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Ideal gasનું equilibrium pressure, volume, amount તથા absolute temperature જોડતું equation ideal-gas equation છે.

body.en:
Derivation—direct ordered steps

  1. At fixed n, T, Boyle gives V∝1/P; at fixed n, P, Charles gives V∝T.
  2. At fixed P, T, Avogadro gives V∝n.Combine independent proportionalities:V∝nT/P.
  3. Introduce the universal proportionality constant R:V=RnT/P.Therefore PV=nRT.
  4. For fixed n, P1V1/T1=P2V2/T2.For changing n, PV/(nT)=R.
  5. Use n=m/M to get PV=(m/M)RT.Then ρ=m/V=PM/(RT).
  6. Dimensions:nRT has pressure×volume units; use K and absolute P, not°C or gauge pressure.
body.gu:
તારવણી—સીધાં ક્રમબદ્ધ પગલાં

  1. Fixed n, Tમાં Boyle V∝1/P; fixed n, Pમાં Charles V∝T.
  2. Fixed P, Tમાં Avogadro V∝n; combine કરતાં V∝nT/P.
  3. Universal constant R મૂકતાં V=RnT/P; અેથી PV=nRT.
  4. Fixed nમાં P1V1/T1=P2V2/T2; changing nમાં PV/(nT)=R.
  5. n=m/Mથી PV=(m/M)RT; તેથી ρ=m/V=PM/(RT).
  6. nRTના units pressure×volume છે; K/absolute P લો, °C/gauge નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

STP and NTP are reference temperature-pressure conventions; the numerical convention must be stated before using a standard gas volume.

Explanation and use

  • Traditional textbook STP:273.15K and1atm=101.325kPa, ideal molar volume≈22.414m³/kmol.Modern IUPAC standard-pressure STP uses273.15K and100kPa, volume≈22.711m³/kmol.
  • NTP is not unique; 20°C and1atm is one common convention, with Vm≈24.055m³/kmol.Some texts use other values.Always follow given data.
  • If an exam says STP without numbers, state the assumed textbook convention before calculation.Never combine22.414 with100kPa silently.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

STP/NTP reference T–P conventions છે; standard gas volume પહેલાં numerical convention લખવું જરૂરી છે.

સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Traditional textbook STP:273.15K, 1atm=101.325kPa; Vm≈22.414m³/kmol.Modern IUPAC100kPa STPમાં273.15K, Vm≈22.711m³/kmol.
  • NTP unique નથી; 20°C/1atm common conventionમાં Vm≈24.055m³/kmol.બીજા textsમાં જુદા values હોય; આપેલી conditions અનુસરો.
  • Examમાં numerical STP ન હોય તો assumed textbook convention પહેલાં લખો.22.414ને100kPa સાથે ચુપચાપ ન જોડો.

body.en:
Definition

Dalton adds ideal-mixture partial pressures at common T, V; Amagat adds ideal partial volumes at common T, P.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Dalton common T, Vએ ideal partial pressures ઉમેરે; Amagat common T, Pએ ideal partial volumes ઉમેરે છે.

h.en: Direct derivation: Dalton’s and Amagat’s laws
h.gu: સીધી તારવણી: Dalton તથા Amagatના નિયમો

body.en:
Derivation—direct ordered steps

  1. For component i acting alone at mixture T, V, piV=niRT.Total PV=ntRT; divide to get pi/P=ni/nt=yi.
  2. Thus pi=yiP and P=Σpi:Dalton’s law.
  3. For component i at mixture T, P, Vi=niRT/P.Total V=ntRT/P, so Vi/V=ni/nt=yi.
  4. Thus V=ΣVi:Amagat’s law.Partial volumes are hypothetical pure-component volumes at the same T, P, not physically separate regions in the mixture.
body.gu:
તારવણી—સીધાં ક્રમબદ્ધ પગલાં

  1. Component i માટે mixture T, Vએ piV=niRT; total PV=ntRT; divideથી pi/P=ni/nt=yi.
  2. અેથી pi=yiP, P=Σpi:Daltonનો નિયમ.
  3. Mixture T, Pએ Vi=niRT/P; total V=ntRT/P; તેથી Vi/V=ni/nt=yi.
  4. અેથી V=ΣVi:Amagatનો નિયમ.Partial volumes સમાન T, Pનાં hypothetical pure-component volumes છે, mixtureમાં જુદા physical regions નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

Raoult relates vapour partial pressure to liquid mole fraction and pure-component saturation pressure in an ideal liquid solution; Henry relates dilute dissolved-gas concentration to its equilibrium partial pressure.

Explanation and use

  • Raoult:pi=xiPsat, i(T).For an ideal vapour mixture, P=ΣxiPsat, i and yi=pi/P.Distinguish liquid xi from vapour yi.
  • Henry convention used here:pi=Hi xi, so Hi has pressure units.Alternative concentration forms c=kH p use different constants and units; never interchange them.
  • Raoult is appropriate to ideal-solution behaviour; Henry describes a dilute-solute limit with stated solvent, T and constant convention.Neither is a general formula for arbitrary concentrated nonideal mixtures.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Raoult ideal liquid solutionમાં vapour partial pressureને liquid mole fraction/Psat સાથે જોડે; Henry dilute dissolved gasને equilibrium partial pressure સાથે જોડે છે.

સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Raoult:pi=xiPsat, i(T).Ideal vapourમાં P=ΣxiPsat, i, yi=pi/P.Liquid xi/vapour yi જુદાં રાખો.
  • અહીં Henry convention pi=Hi xi, અેથી Hi pressure unitsમાં.Other c=kH p formsનાં constants/units જુદાં; interchange ન કરવું.
  • Raoult ideal-solution behaviour માટે; Henry stated solvent, T/conventionમાં dilute-solute limit માટે.Arbitrary concentrated nonideal mixture માટે universal નથી.

title.en: Gas percentages,mean molar mass,density and SG

h.en: Gas percentages,mean molar mass,density and SG

body.en:
Definition

Ideal-gas composition has equal mole, partial-volume and partial-pressure fractions at the stated common conditions; mass fractions usually differ.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Ideal gasમાં common conditionsએ mole, partial-volume/partial-pressure fractions સમાન હોય; mass fractions સામાન્ય રીતે જુદાં હોય છે.

h.en: Direct derivation: Gas percentages,mean molar mass,density and SG
h.gu: સીધી તારવણી: Gas Percent,Molar Mass,Density તથા SG

body.en:
Derivation—direct ordered steps

  1. Dalton gives pi/P=ni/nt=yi; Amagat gives Vi/V=ni/nt=yi.Therefore mole%=volume%=pressure%=100yi for an ideal gas mixture.
  2. Total mass m=ΣniMi=ntΣyiMi.Define Mbar=m/nt=ΣyiMi.
  3. Mass fraction wi=niMi/m=yiMi/Mbar; inverse yi=(wi/Mi)/Σ(wj/Mj).
  4. From PV=ntRT, ρ=m/V=PMbar/(RT).At same T, P, SGgas/air=ρgas/ρair=Mbar/Mair; use stated Mair≈28.97kg/kmol.
  5. These percentage equalities do not imply equal mass%.Wet-gas fractions include water; dry-gas fractions renormalise after excluding water vapour.
body.gu:
તારવણી—સીધાં ક્રમબદ્ધ પગલાં

  1. Daltonથી pi/P=ni/nt=yi, Amagatથી Vi/V=ni/nt=yi; તેથી ideal gasમાં mole%=volume%=pressure%=100yi.
  2. m=ΣniMi=ntΣyiMi; અેથી Mbar=m/nt=ΣyiMi.
  3. wi=niMi/m=yiMi/Mbar; inverse yi=(wi/Mi)/Σ(wj/Mj).
  4. PV=ntRTથી ρ=PMbar/(RT).સમાન T, Pમાં SGgas/air=Mbar/Mair; stated Mair≈28.97kg/kmol લો.
  5. આ equality mass% સમાન કહેતી નથી.Wet gasમાં water સામેલ; dry gasમાં water કાઢીને fractions renormalise થાય.

body.en:
Illustrative solved numerical;not laboratory readings.

Given data

Pabs=200kPa; V=2.0m³; T=300K; R=8.314kPa·m³/(kmol·K).

To find

Find gas amount in kmol.

Formula / necessary assumptions

n=PV/(RT); ideal gas, absolute P, T.

Calculation

  1. n=(200×2)/(8.314×300)=0.160372kmol.

Final answer

n≈0.1604kmol.

Check

kPa·m³ cancels with R; do not use mol-valued R with kmol units incorrectly.
body.gu:
સમજ માટે ઉકેલેલો દાખલો;પ્રયોગની readings નથી.

આપેલી માહિતી

Pabs=200kPa; V=2.0m³; T=300K; R=8.314kPa·m³/(kmol·K).

શું શોધવું

Gas amount kmolમાં શોધો.

સૂત્ર / જરૂરી ધારણાઓ

n=PV/(RT); ideal gas, absolute P, T.

ગણતરી

  1. n=(200×2)/(8.314×300)=0.160372kmol.

અંતિમ જવાબ

n≈0.1604kmol.

ચકાસણી

kPa·m³ R સાથે cancel થાય; mol/kmol basis ભેળવશો નહીં.

body.en:
Illustrative solved numerical;not laboratory readings.

Given data

V1=1.0m³; P1=100kPa; T1=300K; P2=200kPa; T2=400K; same gas amount.

To find

Find V2.

Formula / necessary assumptions

P1V1/T1=P2V2/T2.

Calculation

  1. V2=V1(P1/P2)(T2/T1)=1×(100/200)×(400/300).
  2. V2=0.666667m³.

Final answer

V2≈0.6667m³.

Check

Pressure doubles while T rises by4/3, so volume becomes2/3of original.
body.gu:
સમજ માટે ઉકેલેલો દાખલો;પ્રયોગની readings નથી.

આપેલી માહિતી

V1=1.0m³; P1=100kPa; T1=300K; P2=200kPa; T2=400K; same gas amount.

શું શોધવું

V2 શોધો.

સૂત્ર / જરૂરી ધારણાઓ

P1V1/T1=P2V2/T2.

ગણતરી

  1. V2=V1(P1/P2)(T2/T1)=1×(100/200)×(400/300).
  2. V2=0.666667m³.

અંતિમ જવાબ

V2≈0.6667m³.

ચકાસણી

P બે ગણી, T4/3ગણી એટલે V મૂળનું2/3.

body.en:
Illustrative solved numerical;not laboratory readings.

Given data

n=2kmol; R=8.3144626kPa·m³/(kmol·K).

To find

Find volume at273.15K/101.325kPa, 273.15K/100kPa and293.15K/101.325kPa.

Formula / necessary assumptions

V=nRT/P; all conditions explicitly specified.

Calculation

  1. Vtraditional=2×8.3144626×273.15/101.325=44.8279m³.
  2. V100kPa=2×8.3144626×273.15/100=45.4219m³.
  3. V20°C=2×8.3144626×293.15/101.325=48.1102m³.

Final answer

Volumes≈44.828, 45.422, 48.110m³ respectively.

Check

A reference label alone is insufficient; different declared T/P give different volumes.
body.gu:
સમજ માટે ઉકેલેલો દાખલો;પ્રયોગની readings નથી.

આપેલી માહિતી

n=2kmol; R=8.3144626kPa·m³/(kmol·K).

શું શોધવું

આપેલી ત્રણ reference conditionsએ volume શોધો.

સૂત્ર / જરૂરી ધારણાઓ

V=nRT/P; all conditions explicitly specified.

ગણતરી

  1. Vtraditional=2×8.3144626×273.15/101.325=44.8279m³.
  2. V100kPa=2×8.3144626×273.15/100=45.4219m³.
  3. V20°C=2×8.3144626×293.15/101.325=48.1102m³.

body.en:
Illustrative solved numerical;not laboratory readings.

Given data

yN2=0.80, yCO2=0.20; MN2=28, MCO2=44kg/kmol; P=100kPa, T=300K; R=8.314; Mair=28.97.

To find

Find mean M, mass fractions, density, SG and partial pressures.

Formula / necessary assumptions

Mbar=ΣyiMi; wi=yiMi/Mbar; ρ=PMbar/(RT); SG=Mbar/Mair; pi=yiP.

Calculation

  1. Mbar=0.8×28+0.2×44=31.2kg/kmol.
  2. wN2=22.4/31.2=0.717949; wCO2=8.8/31.2=0.282051.
  3. ρ=100×31.2/(8.314×300)=1.25090kg/m³; SG=31.2/28.97=1.07698.
  4. pN2=80kPa; pCO2=20kPa; ideal volume%=80%, 20%.

Final answer

Mbar=31.2; w≈0.71795/0.28205; ρ≈1.2509kg/m³; SG≈1.077; p=80/20kPa.

Check

Mass fractions sum to1 and partial pressures sum to100kPa.
body.gu:
સમજ માટે ઉકેલેલો દાખલો;પ્રયોગની readings નથી.

આપેલી માહિતી

yN2=0.80, yCO2=0.20; MN2=28, MCO2=44kg/kmol; P=100kPa, T=300K; R=8.314; Mair=28.97.

શું શોધવું

Mean M, mass fractions, density, SG/partial pressures શોધો.

સૂત્ર / જરૂરી ધારણાઓ

Mbar=ΣyiMi; wi=yiMi/Mbar; ρ=PMbar/(RT); SG=Mbar/Mair; pi=yiP.

ગણતરી

  1. Mbar=0.8×28+0.2×44=31.2kg/kmol.
  2. wN2=22.4/31.2=0.717949; wCO2=8.8/31.2=0.282051.
  3. ρ=100×31.2/(8.314×300)=1.25090kg/m³; SG=31.2/28.97=1.07698.
  4. pN2=80kPa; pCO2=20kPa; ideal volume%=80%, 20%.

અંતિમ જવાબ

Mbar=31.2; w≈0.71795/0.28205; ρ≈1.2509kg/m³; SG≈1.077; p=80/20kPa.

ચકાસણી

Mass fractionsનો sum1, partial pressuresનો sum100kPa.

body.en:
Illustrative solved numerical;not laboratory readings.

Given data

Ideal liquid:xA=0.40, xB=0.60; at stated T, Psat, A=100kPa, Psat, B=50kPa; ideal vapour.

To find

Find partial pressures, total pressure and vapour composition.

Formula / necessary assumptions

pi=xiPsat, i; P=Σpi; yi=pi/P.

Calculation

  1. pA=0.4×100=40kPa; pB=0.6×50=30kPa.
  2. P=40+30=70kPa.
  3. yA=40/70=0.571429; yB=30/70=0.428571.

Final answer

P=70kPa; yA≈0.57143; yB≈0.42857.

Check

More-volatile A is enriched in vapour:yA>xA.Liquid and vapour fractions are not interchangeable.
body.gu:

Ideal liquid:xA=0.40, xB=0.60; at stated T, Psat, A=100kPa, Psat, B=50kPa; ideal vapour.

શું શોધવું

Partial pressures, total pressure/vapour composition શોધો.

સૂત્ર / જરૂરી ધારણાઓ

pi=xiPsat, i; P=Σpi; yi=pi/P.

ગણતરી

  1. pA=0.4×100=40kPa; pB=0.6×50=30kPa.
  2. P=40+30=70kPa.
  3. yA=40/70=0.571429; yB=30/70=0.428571.

અંતિમ જવાબ

P=70kPa; yA≈0.57143; yB≈0.42857.

ચકાસણી

More-volatile A vapourમાં enriched છે:yA>xA.Liquid/vapour fractions interchangeable નથી.

body.en:
Illustrative solved numerical;not laboratory readings.

Given data

Use p=Hx; H=5000kPa at stated T, solvent; p=20kPa.

To find

Find dissolved-solute mole fraction.

Formula / necessary assumptions

x=p/H; dilute solution and matching Henry convention.

Calculation

  1. x=20/5000=0.004.
  2. Mole%=0.004×100=0.4%.

Final answer

x=0.004=0.4mole%.

Check

H has pressure units in this convention; using x=Hp would be dimensionally wrong.

  2. Mole%=0.004×100=0.4%.

body.en:
Illustrative solved numerical;not laboratory readings.

Given data

Wet gas:10mol%H2O, 72mol%N2, 18mol%CO2.

To find

Find dry-gas percentages.

Formula / necessary assumptions

ydry, i=ywet, i/(1−ywater).

Calculation

  1. Dry fraction=1−0.10=0.90.
  2. yN2, dry=0.72/0.90=0.80.
  3. yCO2, dry=0.18/0.90=0.20.

Final answer

Dry gas=80mol%N2, 20mol%CO2.

Check

Dry fractions renormalise to100%; water is excluded from denominator.

q.en: Define: Ideal-gas model and gas constant
q.gu: વ્યાખ્યા આપો: Ideal-Gas Model તથા Gas Constant

a.en: An ideal gas obeys PV=nRT exactly in the model, with negligible molecular volume and no intermolecular interactions except elastic collisions.
a.gu: Ideal gas modelમાં molecular volume negligible તથા elastic collisions સિવાય intermolecular interactions નહીં, અને PV=nRT માન્ય છે.

a.en: The ideal-gas equation relates equilibrium pressure, volume, amount and absolute temperature of an ideal gas.
